_readme: San Antonio food creators Chisme follows, with every platform each one was verified on (2026-09-29). 'uses' says what Chisme pulls in automatically: a YouTube RSS feed (channel_id), hand-picked TikToks (data/food_tiktok.json, checked with TikTok's official oEmbed), or a profile link only (Instagram has no keyless feed or embed). Handles only; nothing is scraped. 'aliases' are other channel names of the same person (their videos count as one creator for variety in For You).
